Description (input code): 1 = present, 0 = absent
Note: Derived using the IDF definition for children and adolescents, from waist, sysBP, diaBP, glucose, HDL and TG

Description (input code): Waist circumference, cm
Note: Not used as a predictor. Source column: 허리둘레

Note: Not used as a predictor. Source columns: 수축기 (2021, 2022); 수축기혈압 (2023, 2024)

Description (input code): Diastolic blood pressure, mmHg
Note: Not used as a predictor. Source columns: 이완기 (2021, 2022); 이완기혈압 (2023, 2024)

Description (input code): Fasting plasma glucose, mg/dL
Note: Blood test, taken only from students screened as obese in the 4th grade of elementary school, the 1st grade of middle school and the 1st grade of high school. Not used as a predictor. Source columns: 혈당(식전)(mg/dl) (2021); 혈당식전mgdl (2022); 식전혈당 (2023, 2024)

Description (input code): HDL cholesterol, mg/dL

Description (input code): Triglycerides, mg/dL
Note: Blood test, taken only from students screened as obese in the 4th grade of elementary school, the 1st grade of middle school and the 1st grade of high school. Not used as a predictor. Source columns: 중성지방(mg/dl) (2021); 중성지방mgdl (2022); 중성지방_TG (2023); 중성지방(TG) (2024)

Description (input code): Male, female
Note: Recoded as 1 = male, 0 = female. Source column: 성별

Description (input code): Date of birth YYYY-MM-DD, examination date YYYY-MM-DD
Note: Derived as (examination date − date of birth) / 365.25, in years. Source columns: 생년월일, 건강검진일

Description (input code): Elementary School, 4th grade (9-10y); Middle School, 1st grade (12-13y); High School, 1st grade (15-16y)
Note: Recoded as 1, 2 and 3. The source input codes are 초, 중, 고; combined with the grade variable the sample is restricted to these three grades. Ages are completed years. Because the metabolic syndrome criteria change from the pediatric to the adult definition at 16 years, both sets apply within the 1st grade of high school. Source columns: 학교급, 학년

Description (input code): Measured height, measured weight
Note: Derived as weight / (height / 100) squared, in kg/m2. Source columns: 키, 몸무게

Description (input code): Total cholesterol, mg/dL
Note: Blood test, taken only from students screened as obese in the 4th grade of elementary school, the 1st grade of middle school and the 1st grade of high school. Source columns: 총콜레스테롤(mg/dl) (2021); 총콜레스테롤mgdl (2022); 총콜레스테롤 (2023, 2024)

Description (input code): LDL cholesterol, mg/dL
Note: Blood test, taken only from students screened as obese in the 4th grade of elementary school, the 1st grade of middle school and the 1st grade of high school. Source columns: ldl(mg/dl) (2021); ldlmgdl (2022); 저밀도지단백콜레스테롤_LDL (2023); 저밀도지단백콜레스테롤(LDL) (2024)

Description (input code): Aspartate aminotransferase, U/L
Note: Blood test, taken only from students screened as obese in the 4th grade of elementary school, the 1st grade of middle school and the 1st grade of high school. Source columns: AST(U/L) (2021); astul (2022); 간세포효소_AST (2023); 간세포효소(AST) (2024)

Description (input code): Alanine aminotransferase, U/L
Note: Blood test, taken only from students screened as obese in the 4th grade of elementary school, the 1st grade of middle school and the 1st grade of high school. Source columns: ALT(U/L) (2021); altul (2022); 간세포효소_ALT (2023); 간세포효소(ALT) (2024)

Description (input code): How many hours do you usually sleep per day? (1) within 6 hours (2) 6 to 7 hours (3) 7 to 8 hours (4) 8 hours or more
Note: The first and last categories are open-ended, so the item was not converted to hours. The ordered response code 1 to 4 is entered into the models. Source column: 하루수면량

Description (input code): (Elementary) Do you exercise hard enough to become short of breath or sweat at least three times a week? (1) yes (2) no / (Middle and high) On how many days a week do you exercise hard enough to become short of breath or sweat for 30 minutes to 1 hour or more? (1) almost never (2) 1-2 days (3) 3-4 days (4) 5 days or more
Note: Combined into 1 = meets the activity criterion, 0 = does not. For elementary school response (1) counts as meeting it; for middle and high school responses (3) and (4) do. Source columns: 주3회이상운동 (elementary); 하루30분이상운동 (middle and high)

Description (input code): In a week, about how often do you eat instant noodles / sugary drinks / fast food / meat / milk and dairy / fruit / vegetables excluding kimchi? (1) none (2) 1-2 times (3) 3-5 times (4) every day / How do you take breakfast? (1) almost always (2) usually (3) usually not (4) almost never
Note: Summed index from 0 to 24, each of the eight items scored 0 to 3. Instant noodles, sugary drinks and fast food are reverse-scored. All eight items are required. Source columns: 라면, 음료수, 패스트푸드, 육류, 우유유제품, 과일, 채소(김치제외), 아침식사

Description (input code): Have you done any of the following to lose weight? (select all that apply) (1) nothing (2) control my diet (3) take medication (4) lose weight through exercise
Note: Option (2) of the multiple-response item. 1 = reported, 0 = not reported. Source column: 다이어트경험_답변2

Description (input code): Same item as above (weight-control multiple response)
Note: Option (3) of the multiple-response item. 1 = reported, 0 = not reported. Source column: 다이어트경험_답변3

Description (input code): Same item as above (weight-control multiple response)
Note: Option (4) of the multiple-response item. 1 = reported, 0 = not reported. Source column: 다이어트경험_답변4

Description (input code): Same item as above (weight-control multiple response)
Note: Derived. 1 if any of options (2), (3) or (4) was reported, 0 otherwise. Option (1) of the source item is not used

Description (input code): In the past year I have been bullied or excluded by friends. (1) yes (2) no
Note: 1 = yes, 0 = no. In 2021 and 2022 the item was held in separate columns for elementary and for middle and high school, which were combined. Source columns: 괴롭힘따돌림_초, 괴롭힘따돌림_중고 (2021, 2022); 괴롭힘따돌림 (2023, 2024)

Description (input code): (Elementary) I often want to leave home. (1) yes (2) no / (Middle and high) In the past year I have seriously considered running away from home. (1) yes (2) no
Note: 1 = yes, 0 = no. In 2021 and 2022 the item was held in separate columns by school level, which were combined. Source columns: 가출생각_초, 가출생각_중고 (2021); 가출생각_초, 가출생각중고 (2022); 가출생각 (2023, 2024)

Note: 1 = yes, 0 = no. From 2021 to 2023 the item was held in separate columns by school level, which were combined. Source columns: 상담희망_초, 상담희망_중고 (2021); 학교문제상담희망_초, 학교문제상담희망_중고 (2022, 2023); 상담희망 (2024)

Description (input code): I would like counseling about worries or distress. (1) yes (2) no
Note: 1 = yes, 0 = no. In 2021 and 2022 the item was held in separate columns by school level, which were combined. Source columns: 상담요청_초, 상담요청_중고 (2021, 2022); 상담요청 (2023); 고민상담요청 (2024)

Description (input code): Measured height, measured weight, sex, age
Note: Derived by applying the LMS method to the 2017 Korean National Growth Charts for children and adolescents. Reported in Table 1 but not entered into any model

Description (input code): Compared with your friends, what do you think of your own body shape? (1) very thin (2) slightly thin (3) average (4) slightly overweight (5) very overweight

Description (input code): I spend two hours or more a day on the internet or on games. (1) yes (2) no
Note: Removed as a variable because it was unavailable for 97.0% of middle-school students in 2024. Source columns: 하루2시간이상게임_초, 하루2시간이상게임_중고 (2021, 2022, 2023); 2시간이상게임 (2024)

Description (input code): I worry about problems within my family. (1) yes (2) no
Note: Removed as a variable because it was unavailable for all elementary-school students in every year. Source column: 가정문제걱정
